name: patch-writer
description: Write Morphe patches — fingerprints, patch logic, and constants from analysis findings

agentSpawn.command: PATCHES_DIR="${MORPHE_PATCHES_DIR:-morphe-patches}"; echo '--- Existing Patches ---' && find "${PATCHES_DIR}/patches/src/main/kotlin" -mindepth 4 -maxdepth 4 -type d 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} basename {} || echo 'No patches yet'

postToolUse.command: PATCHES_DIR="${MORPHE_PATCHES_DIR:-morphe-patches}"; if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "${PATCHES_DIR}/patches/src.*\.kt"; then cd "${PATCHES_DIR}" && ./gradlew buildAndroid 2>&1 | tail -5; fi

welcomeMessage:
Patch Writer ready. Give me:
- Analysis findings (findings.md or describe the target)
- Smali method signature and instruction sequence
- App package name and version

I'll create the Fingerprints.kt, Patch.kt, and Constants.kt files. Writing patch .kt files triggers the configured local Gradle build hook.
